vo_open.text: In 1997, the ocean made a sound so big, people wondered what could be down there.

vo.text: American scientists picked it up in the South Pacific, off South America.
vo.cap: *NOAA* picked it up in the *South Pacific.*

vo.text: Sensors up to forty-eight hundred kilometers apart all heard it.
vo.cap: Sensors up to *4,800 km* apart *all heard it.*

vo.text: Some wondered if a creature bigger than any whale was out there.
The answer came in 2012. It wasn't alive.
vo.cap: The answer came in *2012.* It *wasn't alive.*

vo.text: It was an icequake: Antarctic ice, cracking and breaking apart.
The ocean's great mystery monster was ice.
